explainer.lead: Mobileye Global Inc. is a US-domiciled, Israel-headquartered company developing physical AI technologies, including self-driving, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) and humanoid robotics. It matters as a major supplier of automotive perception and driving-automation technology.

tiers.eli5: It's a company that builds the eyes and brains for cars, helping them see the road and assist or take over driving.
tiers.practitioner: Automakers integrate Mobileye's perception and ADAS systems into vehicles rather than building driving automation from scratch. The pitfall is that real-world driving edge cases remain the hard part, so assistance systems still require careful validation and driver oversight.
tiers.paperLevel: A company rather than a formal method; its work spans ADAS and self-driving systems along with humanoid robotics. It was acquired by Intel in 2017 and went public again in 2022.

explainer.example: A carmaker might ship a vehicle whose lane-keeping and collision-warning features run on Mobileye's ADAS technology.
